correctness.rationale: For all a,b>=1 and exactly three synchronous cyclic colors, the update factors through 49 nonempty shore-support pairs (A,B), with each color transformed by the opposite shore successor-support test. I independently computed all 49 support transitions, obtaining only diagonal singleton fixed supports, full/full fixed support, and three two-cycles ((3,5),(3,6),(5,6) and their reverses); every other support enters within <=2 steps. Applying the exact labelled update shows the support two-cycles induce four-step labelled, not two-step, periods. Surjective-coloring counts on a labelled shore are S1=1, S2=2^m-2=U_m, S3=3^m-3*2^m+3=R_m. The six table populations are respectively 3, R_a R_b, 6 U_a U_b, 6+3(U_a+U_b+U_a U_b), 3(U_a R_b+R_a U_b), and 6(U_a+U_b)+3(R_a+R_b); they sum to 3^(a+b), giving F^14=F^2 and orbit counts by division by primitive periods. An independently coded brute-force labelled update checked all six (T,p) classes for 16 shore pairs a,b=1..4, each up to 3^8 configurations; the complete finite support classification and surjection identity—not a finite-size extrapolation—prove all dimensions. The stated exceptional conditional probability follows from the exact complement identity and min(a,b)->infinity estimates.
